title: jung__ie
description: Full-stack ecommerce platform for a LA-based pottery brand featuring one-of-a-kind handcrafted ceramics with an email-based reservation system.
details: Architected a serverless full-stack application using Next.js 15 App Router deployed to AWS Lambda behind CloudFront.
Provisioned and managed AWS infrastructure (RDS, S3, Lambda, CloudFront) entirely through Terraform for reproducible Infrastructure as Code.
Designed a normalized PostgreSQL schema with Drizzle ORM, implementing type-safe queries and version-controlled SQL migrations.

Built a reservation system tailored to one-of-a-kind pottery — customers reserve pieces via email with their preferred payment method (Stripe, PayPal, Venmo, Zelle) rather than traditional cart checkout.
Containerized local development with Docker Compose, running Next.js and PostgreSQL in isolated services with health checks and automatic migrations.
Integrated PostHog for product analytics and behavioral event tracking to inform design decisions.
Planned roadmap for AI integration including rate-limited LLM API calls and customer-facing agents for product recommendations.

title: stock ₩on
description: A personal stock research platform that automates equity analysis using AWS serverless infrastructure and LLM-powered document summarization. Ingests prices, news, SEC filings, and federal policy actions, then delivers a curated email newsletter every other day with quarterly narratives, watchlist snapshots, and policy impact analysis.
role: Solo Developer — Architecture, Infrastructure, Backend, Prompt Engineering
details: Designed an event-driven serverless architecture on AWS to ingest, process, and store financial data from yfinance, Financial Modeling Prep, NewsAPI, SEC EDGAR, and the Federal Register API.

Built LLM-powered summarization pipelines using Amazon Bedrock with Claude Sonnet and Haiku, applying model selection by task complexity to summarize 10-K filings, earnings calls, news articles, and policy actions while keeping monthly Bedrock costs under $10.

Engineered a 'Policy Watch' layer that monitors executive orders and political news from the Federal Register and surfaces regulatory developments affecting tracked equities — a research angle absent from comparable retail platforms.
Provisioned the entire stack with Terraform using remote state in S3 with DynamoDB locking, IAM least-privilege roles per Lambda, and SSM Parameter Store for secret management.

Implemented a stratified newsletter delivered every other day via Amazon SES, combining always-on sections (market overview, watchlist snapshot), event-triggered sections (earnings primers, 10-K digests), and a rotating AI deep-dive on individual tickers.
Authored version-controlled prompts engineered for factual, unbiased extraction — explicitly avoiding buy/sell recommendations or predictive language — to support long-horizon investment research.

title: World Relief
description: A full-stack web application built for real-time data visualization. The challenge was making complex datasets feel intuitive and beautiful.
details: Architected a REST API serving real-time data to a React frontend.
Built custom D3.js visualizations for 6 distinct data views.
Implemented WebSocket connections for live-updating dashboards.
Optimized database queries to handle 10k+ concurrent users.

title: AI Resume Builder
description: Redesigning a mobile experience to reduce friction and increase engagement. Every screen was rethought from the ground up.
details: AI Resume Builder to help job seekers create tailored resumes with AI-powered content suggestions and formatting. The redesign focused on simplifying the user flow, improving accessibility, and adding interactive features to enhance engagement.
New challenges daily to keep users to try something new
Built interactive prototypes for usability testing across 3 iterations.
The redesign increased conversion rate by 28% in the first quarter.
